insight: Founded in 2014, Textio coined the term "augmented writing"; it says ~25% of the Fortune 500 have used it.
name: Textio
tagline: Augmented-writing guidance that strips bias from job posts and performance feedback.
description: Textio is an AI writing platform built for HR: it gives real-time guidance as managers and recruiters write job posts, recruiting emails, and performance reviews, flagging biased or off-tone language before it goes out. Its models are trained on a large corpus of HR documents rather than general text, and it ships separate products for recruiting and for manager feedback.

modelSupport.notes: Proprietary models trained on a large corpus of hiring and performance-management documents.

edge: Purpose-trained on HR-specific language for hiring and feedback, where general writing assistants aren't tuned for bias or legal risk.

references.title: This AI Tool Makes Job Descriptions More Inclusive
Augmented writing platform Textio now predicts what you want to say
